subject.title: feat(plugins): support per-agent plugin installation with --agent flag

question: Should OpenClaw expose agent-scoped plugin installs as a core CLI/config contract now, and what validation, discovery, update, uninstall, and security semantics must land before merge?
rationale: The PR changes where plugin code is installed and how persisted plugin lifecycle records are identified, which affects operator security boundaries and upgrade behavior beyond a mechanical patch decision.

options.title: Complete Lifecycle Contract Before Merge
options.body: Require scoped identity, configured-agent validation, update/uninstall cleanup, registry/index behavior, doctor/docs, and real behavior proof before exposing the flag.

options.title: Pause On The Feature Issue
options.body: Keep this PR open but blocked while maintainers decide the durable product and security contract in the linked issue.

options.title: Accept Install-Only Scope Deliberately
options.body: Maintainers could merge the partial install surface as an experiment, but operators would inherit known uninstall, update, discovery, and trust-boundary gaps.

recommendation.title: Complete Lifecycle Contract Before Merge
recommendation.body: Require scoped identity, configured-agent validation, update/uninstall cleanup, registry/index behavior, doctor/docs, and real behavior proof before exposing the flag.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent plugin lifecycle history and broader control-plane ownership signals make steipete the best available decision owner from the local evidence.
